# Why This Project?

#### Course: Learn C++ Basics

## Why This Project?

Here's a quick peek at what you'll build:

![Rock, Paper, Scissors Game Demo](data:image/gif;base64,)

This project is about more than just writing code. It's about building something from scratch and seeing it come to life.

Here's what you'll get out of it:

1. Practice applying everything you've learned
2. Learn how to structure a project like a real developer
3. Break problems into steps and write clean, reusable code
4. Build something you can run, play, tweak, and share

It's a hands-on way to make your knowledge stick—and have fun doing it.

##### How does it work?

Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
